summary: Six-phase, 5.5-hour plan written from the round-01 research. Phase 1 is a declared atomic batch over both scripts (per-file layer table keyed on pre-merge origin, fail-loud layer_of, stale-row report, allowlist restored from measured output) because either half alone leaves check-metalogic-cycles.sh red in CI. Phase 2 adds the named syntax-before-semantics assertion with a non-vacuity guard; Phase 3 runs six hand negative tests with save-and-restore; Phases 4 and 5 (parallel) update six repository documents, the three language READMEs and the three aggregator docstrings; Phase 6 re-runs the whole gate. The three aggregator .lean files are added beyond the task's recorded file_scope (docstring-only; measured rebuild about 30 modules).

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan covering the layer table and fail-loud lookup, restored allowlist, third assertion, negative tests, document updates and final gate.

next_action_hint: Implement Phase 1 as one atomic commit over scripts/measure-refactor-partitions.py and scripts/check-metalogic-cycles.sh; if the measured upward set is anything other than the 7 AxiomDischarge lines, block and report rather than allowlist.
